notes.first_measurement: 2026-10-31 (12 paired campaigns, 3 replicates). Full marks in every run of both arms: dispatch-check C1 to C4 (the whole case), collect-returns C2, tiny-ask C1, C3 and C4. Kept as floors: dispatch-check (a plan with an unfilled placeholder, overlapping writes and no cap stays blocked) and tiny-ask C1 (a tiny ask stays inline). notes.status: Template, not registered here. Registering writes prereg.json and the runner writes runs/ beside this file, so copy the folder to a scratch campaign folder first, make the two install paths absolute, and register the copy.
notes.skill_arm: The runner copies only what ships into each work folder (no evals/ or tests/), so these rubrics and canaries stay out of it and the arm can point at the package folder itself. The skill is manual only, so the skill arm reaches it through its prefix, the typed command.
